objects.description: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) executed [CHOPSTICK](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0023) by using rundll32 commands such as rundll32.exe “C:\Windows\twain_64.dll”. [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) also executed a .dll for a first stage dropper using rundll32.exe. An [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) loader Trojan saved a batch script that uses rundll32 to execute a DLL payload.(Citation: Crowdstrike DNC June 2016)(Citation: Bitdefender APT28 Dec 2015)(Citation: Palo Alto Sofacy 06-2018)(Citation: Unit 42 Playbook Dec 2017)(Citation: ESET Zebrocy May 2019)(Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory GRU Brute Force Campaign July 2021)
objects.description_fa: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) [CHOPSTICK](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0023) را با استفاده از دستورات rundll32 مانند rundll32.exe “C:\Windows\twain_64.dll” اجرا کرد. [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) همچنین یک dll. را برای یک dropper مرحله اول با استفاده از rundll32.exe اجرا کرد. یک تروجان بارگیری [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) یک اسکریپت دسته ای را ذخیره کرد که از rundll32 برای اجرای یک DLL استفاده می کند. محموله.(Citation: Crowdstrike DNC June 2016)(Citation: Bitdefender APT28 Dec 2015)(Citation: Palo Alto Sofacy 06-2018)(Citation: Unit 42 Playbook Dec 2017)(Citation: ESET Zebrocy May 2019)[[[CTI_PRESERVE_6]] (Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory GRU Brute Force Campaign July 2021)
